evaluation: Forward-chaining CV: for each of the 6 calendar weeks from 25 Oct to 9 Dec, the model was trained only on data before that week and then forecast the week with the full causal pipeline. RMSE against 15-min sums of the raw meter readings (excluding -999 intervals and the 2 catch-up pulses) was 0.89 kWh (0.74 on the cleaned, healthy-meter target; weekly 0.57-1.13), against 2.25 for 1-h persistence and 1.04 for a time-of-day profile. Truncating or garbling the file after T-45 min left every forecast unchanged.
data_findings: 1) Timestamps: 5-min data, weekdays only, with gaps (9 Sep; 23 Sep 14:00-24 Sep 02:00; 2-24 Oct; 18 Nov-8 Dec). The file is not in order: 21:00-23:25 on 28 Oct is written in reverse, and 15 Nov 01:10-16 Nov 01:05 appears twice (288 identical duplicate rows). Fix: parse the +08:00 timestamps, stable-sort, drop duplicate timestamps, put everything on a regular 5-min grid (missing rows stay NaN). 2) Sentinels/strings: chilled_water_energy has 17 values of -999 and outdoor_relative_humidity has 14 'OFFLINE' strings. Fix: coerce to numeric and set <= -900 to NaN; intervals with a -999 are left out of the training targets. 3) Unit change: air_temperature switches to Fahrenheit from 2021-11-08 04:45 (79-85). Fix: each row above 50 is converted F->C on its own (no whole-file statistics). 4) dry_bulb_temp has isolated spikes of about +17.8 C (up to 50.7 C). Fix: a backward-looking Hampel filter (trailing 1-hour median) sets them to NaN. 5) Dead chilled-water meter: it reads exactly 0 while the AHU fan is on and the cooling valve is ~40% open, from 21 Sep to 26 Oct 10:25 and again from 17 Nov 15:35 (supply_air_flow/damper are frozen, NaN or 0 over much of the same period). Fix: these intervals are left out of training, and at forecast time, if the 3 or more most recent AHU-on readings (observed within the last 72 h) are 0, the forecast is 0, because the meter keeps reading 0 in that state. 6) Communication-loss catch-up pulses: on 13 Sep 16:40-17:20 all points freeze and are followed by a single 14.44 kWh reading (the accumulated energy); on 17 Nov there is 13.6 kWh at 15:30 after zeros. Fix: these and the zero run before them are left out of the training targets; in the inputs, readings above 7 kWh per 5 min are set to NaN. 7) Stuck value: chilled_water_energy repeats 0.4846 for 183 rows (3 Nov 18:40 to 4 Nov 10:00) while the fan is off and the valve shut. Fix: when the valve has been shut and the fan off for at least 10 min, the reading is set to 0; any other non-zero value repeated 3 times is set to NaN. 8) supply_air_flow sits on constants (1942.83, 93.15) or NaN for weeks, damper_position has long NaN runs, and offcoil_temp_setpoint never changes. These are not used as model inputs. 9) Operation: the AHU runs on a fixed schedule, 08:05-18:40 on every weekday. On the 4 Nov public holiday (Deepavali) it ran 10:05-17:40, so the schedule features use a Singapore public-holiday list. Chilled-water use bumps up every day at 18:15-18:30. Because the 08:00-08:45 start-up intervals can only be forecast from the schedule, they cause the largest errors.
model: Average of two gradient-boosted tree ensembles (sklearn HistGradientBoosting; exported to numpy so predict() does not need sklearn). They use 21 causal features: chilled-water lags (the block [T-60,T-45) and earlier), the last 5-min reading at T-50, valve command, AHU on/off, whether and when the AHU started today, holiday-aware schedule position, previous-day level and same-slot value, a meter-health streak, and room/weather conditions at T-60..T-45. Rules on top: dead-meter gate -> 0; outside the schedule with the AHU off -> at most 0.3; AHU not started by T-50 although scheduled -> at most 0.3.
output: One forecast for every 15-min interval from the first interval in the file to (last timestamp + 50 min). The index is tz-aware local time (UTC+08:00), and every value is finite and >= 0.
